method: One flat os.scandir listing of the canonical source root.
One immediate os.scandir listing of the derived root; no recursive derived-tree scan.
Seven lexicographically evenly spaced source-file spot checks for source metadata and derived-leaf artifact presence.
One observed prototype leaf inspected for artifact schema, array shape/dtype, and text length only.
No image model invocation, semantic image inference, source/derived-tree write, corpus backfill, or hash/full-completion scan.
provenance.sampling_limit: Spot checks establish topology and concrete parity risks only. They are not a modality-completeness estimate.

derived_tree.interpretation: Partial, heterogeneous derived tree; no completion percentage is inferred from this inventory.

observed_prototype_leaf.interpretation: The raw-versus-bucketed view difference is a concrete comparison-parity axis. The observed prototype t52 output remains a legacy 512-token artifact and is not evidence of a 4K context representation.
